opening.argument: The presentation is chart analysis, not a promise of returns. The speaker examines Polkadot levels and explains that an inverse head-and-shoulders pattern depends on a pullback that holds a higher low; larger projections likewise depend on a break and hold. The accompanying material expressly denies guaranteed profit and warns that crypto investments carry risk. The description does promote a crypto school and other external resources, but the supplied material does not tie those promotions to deceptive claims, compulsory participation, or any specified mechanism of financial loss. Conditional market analysis and an invitation to learn more do not, on this record, establish a deceptive offer.
